cases.observed: Earlier phone attempt displayed generic render failure. Source requires a video track in every source. Controlled QA retry reached export sheet, then Mirroring disconnected because the phone was in use.
cases.limit: Known audio-only export limitation. renderMultitrackVideo rejects the first source with no video track; the UI shows only the generic retry alert. Exact installed-build reproduction still needs the controlled retry. No renderer changes applied.
